We are sorry to hear that your appointment had to be cancelled. Unfortunately, when a clinician is unexpectedly absent due to illness, appointments sometimes need to be rearranged at short notice. We recognise this can be frustrating and we regret the inconvenience caused.
When appointments are cancelled for this reason, patients automatically qualify for a new appointment of the same type as the one originally booked. If the replacement appointment offered does not meet a patient’s needs, they are able to complete an eConsult explaining why the new appointment is not suitable or if they feel their issue requires more urgent review. This allows our clinical team to reassess the request and prioritise appropriately.
We are sure you would also wish to join us in wishing our colleague a speedy recovery.
If you would like us to look at your situation in more detail, please contact the practice and we would be happy to review this further.
Kind regards,
